decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - It is considered that the proposed two-storey side extension, because of its position, design and appearance, would be acceptable having due regard for the site characteristics of No. 32 Rochester Avenue and would not be detrimental to the visual amenity of the area or the amenities of the adjoining and neighbouring properties. On balance the development is in accordance with policies ENV-B.1.1, H.4.1 and H.6.4 of the adopted Unitary Development Plan 2003 and is generally compliant with the Council's Residential Extension Guidelines. It is considered that where the development is not compliant there are no undue adverse effects or demonstrable harm resulting from this.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is occupied.

Condition : 5 - The car parking accommodation shown on drawing No. HP 1674 Issue D shall be provided before the dwelling to which it relates is occupied and thereafter it shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles.
description: Erection of a two storey side extension to dwellinghouse
